method: ENTIRELY from ONE AMH page, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED. No passage reproduced, no source_text stored, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable and every statement must be verified by a person against a current subscription. ⚠️ NO DOSE APPEARS ANYWHERE ON THE PAGE -- not for nifedipine, salbutamol, betamethasone, dexamethasone or magnesium sulfate. The GESTATIONAL WINDOWS are the operative numbers and are recorded as dose claims because they decide whether a drug is given at all. AMH points to an external magnesium sulfate document at sahmri.org which was NOT retrieved.

claims.claim: TOCOLYTICS such as NIFEDIPINE AND SALBUTAMOL ARE USED TO DELAY DELIVERY FOR 24-48 HOURS, ALLOWING TIME FOR TRANSFER TO A HOSPITAL WITH APPROPRIATE NEONATAL FACILITIES AND/OR ADMINISTRATION OF CORTICOSTEROIDS
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Preterm labour' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/obstetric-gynaecological-drugs/drugs-obstetrics/drugs-preterm-labour/preterm-labour, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ TOCOLYSIS IS GENERALLY NOT INDICATED BEFORE THE FETUS IS VIABLE, WHEN GESTATION IS OVER 34 WEEKS, OR WHEN PROLONGING THE PREGNANCY IS HAZARDOUS -- eg PLACENTAL ABRUPTION, INTRAUTERINE INFECTION
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Preterm labour' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/obstetric-gynaecological-drugs/drugs-obstetrics/drugs-preterm-labour/preterm-labour, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: NIFEDIPINE IS PREFERRED: IT APPEARS MORE EFFECTIVE THAN SALBUTAMOL -- FEWER BIRTHS WITHIN 7 DAYS OF TREATMENT -- HAS FEWER MATERNAL ADVERSE EFFECTS, AND IS ASSOCIATED WITH REDUCED NEONATAL MORBIDITY. Unlike salbutamol it is GIVEN ORALLY and MAY BE CONSIDERED FOR MAINTENANCE TREATMENT -- ⚠️ HOWEVER SUCH TREATMENT IS CONTROVERSIAL AS EVIDENCE FOR EFFICACY IS LACKING
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Preterm labour' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/obstetric-gynaecological-drugs/drugs-obstetrics/drugs-preterm-labour/preterm-labour, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: BETAMETHASONE OR DEXAMETHASONE GIVEN TO THE MOTHER ACCELERATES FETAL LUNG MATURATION AND REDUCES NEONATAL DEATH, RESPIRATORY DISTRESS SYNDROME AND CEREBROVENTRICULAR HAEMORRHAGE. ⚠️ THERE IS INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE TO RECOMMEND ONE RATHER THAN THE OTHER

claims.claim: ⚠️ REPEAT CORTICOSTEROID COURSES: refer to local protocols or seek specialist advice. ACCORDING TO A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW, REPEAT COURSES HAVE SOME SHORT-TERM BENEFITS -- REDUCED RDS AND MORBIDITY -- COMPARED WITH A SINGLE COURSE, ⚠️ BUT WEIGHT, HEAD CIRCUMFERENCE AND LENGTH ARE REDUCED AT BIRTH. FOLLOW-UP AT 2-3 YEARS OF AGE SUGGESTED NO HARMS, NOR ANY BENEFITS

claims.claim: MAGNESIUM SULFATE, GIVEN TO WOMEN AT RISK OF PRETERM BIRTH, IS NEUROPROTECTIVE AND REDUCES THE RISK OF CEREBRAL PALSY IN THE INFANT. ⚠️ GIVE TO WOMEN UNDER 30 WEEKS GESTATION WHO ARE LIKELY TO DELIVER WITHIN 24 HOURS. ⚠️ NOTE THE THREE GESTATIONAL WINDOWS DIFFER: TOCOLYSIS UP TO 34 WEEKS, CORTICOSTEROIDS AT 24-34 WEEKS, MAGNESIUM SULFATE UNDER 30 WEEKS
